build_dataflow_graph: build a Graph with nodes and edges to model tensor computation dependencies in a neural network
canonicalize_graph: canonicalize a Graph by converting all MultiSourceEdges to regular Edges for uniform analysis
prune_graph: prune a Graph to remove unnecessary undriven copy or fill nodes before canonicalization
dump_graph_to_dot: dump a Graph to a Graphviz DOT file for visualizing the dataflow computation graph
check_graph_consistency: check a Graph for consistency including duplicate sources sinks self edges and cycles
